test: Data-driven sibling-language anchor discovery through the corrected exact mirrored Man Grid

dependency.test5: corrected 50-shard mirror-grid dictionary and exact model
dependency.test6: corrected attested-language candidate pool and language-level root similarity
dependency.test8: corrected reverse-family convergence support by meaning
dependency.test4: not used; Test 4 is treated as the incomplete precursor to corrected Test 5

calculation.language_form_selection: per-language per-meaning medoid under corrected mirror-grid sequence distance
calculation.branch_profile: optimal root-to-language sequence alignment; every aligned phoneme substitution contributes signed normalized row/column movement on each of the ten exact mirrored rectangular layers, yielding a 20-dimensional Grid displacement profile
calculation.discovery: languages are summarized within families; equal-weight family direction profiles define an uncentred principal bipolar axis through the corrected Test 5 root. Branch A/B labels are exchangeable signs, not predefined languages.
calculation.candidate_pool: all corrected Test 6 attested languages with >=10 shared Test 5 meanings; no language is hard-coded as an anchor
calculation.test8_use: primary branch profiles use meanings that independently beat the wrong-meaning convergence control in corrected Test 8
calculation.test7_use: family enrichment is attached only as context after branch discovery and does not determine the axis
calculation.wrong_meaning_control: recompute each language displacement profile against deterministic different Test 5 meanings in the same shard, preserving observed language forms

execution.partition: deterministic disjoint meaning ownership across 20 shards; every shard independently discovers its two-branch axis

evidence_boundary: Test 9 is an unsupervised structural anchor-discovery test. Two opposite labels are exchangeable and describe the strongest bipolar displacement axis found in the corrected Man Grid. A stable anchor pair can support a sibling-branch model but does not by itself establish genealogy, chronology, geography, or literal descent.
